Sources

Open-Meteo ERA5-Seamless: daily highs and rain, maximum 9 am–6 pm wind. Complete 2016–2025 histories; February 29 excluded. Monthly fractions = average nice days ÷ days in the month. The yearly nice-day index divides annual nice days by Palo Alto’s annual nice days under the same settings: Palo Alto all year = 1.00.

CoL uses first-page Redfin asking-price samples for exactly 3 beds / 2 baths, including all residential types. These are sample medians, not citywide sale medians. The portfolio index is weighted by months in each city. Click a city's CoL value for its listing source.
